William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Friends and Foes

[On Cromek]: Cr—— loves artists as he loves his meat

XX
C
R
—— loves artists as he loves his meat:
He loves the Art; but ’tis the art to cheat.
